passages.text: Now the LORD spoke to Moses after the death of two of Aaron’s sons when they approached the presence of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
This happened after two sons of Aaron died.
Aaron was the brother of Moses.
Aaron’s two sons died when they came near to the LORD’s presence.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן בְּקָרְבָתָ֥ם לִפְנֵי־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּמֻֽתוּ׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses: “Tell your brother Aaron not to enter freely into the Most Holy Place behind the veil in front of the mercy seat on the ark, or else he will die, because I appear in the cloud above the mercy seat.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to speak to Aaron.
Aaron was Moses’ brother.
The LORD said Aaron must not enter the Most Holy Place at any time he chooses.
The Most Holy Place is behind the veil.
The Most Holy Place is in front of the mercy seat.
The mercy seat is on the ark.
If Aaron enters at the wrong time, he will die.
The LORD appears in the cloud above the mercy seat.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִיךָ֒ וְאַל־ יָבֹ֤א בְכָל־ עֵת֙ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת אֶל־ פְּנֵ֨י הַכַּפֹּ֜רֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל־ הָאָרֹן֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמ֔וּת כִּ֚י בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן אֵרָאֶ֖ה עַל־ הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃

passages.text: This is how Aaron is to enter the Holy Place: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must enter the Holy Place in a special way.
Aaron must bring a young bull.
The young bull is for a sin offering.
Aaron must also bring a ram.
The ram is for a burnt offering.
passages.original: בְּזֹ֛את יָבֹ֥א אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּפַ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר לְחַטָּ֖את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: He is to wear the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments. He must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are holy garments, and he must bathe himself with water before he wears them.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must wear special clothes when he enters the Holy Place.
He must put on a sacred linen tunic.
He must wear linen undergarments on his body.
He must tie a linen sash around his waist.
He must put a linen turban on his head.
These clothes are holy garments.
Aaron must wash his body with water before he puts on these garments.
passages.original: כְּתֹֽנֶת־ בַּ֨ד קֹ֜דֶשׁ יִלְבָּ֗שׁ וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־ בַד֮ יִהְי֣וּ עַל־ בְּשָׂרוֹ֒ וּבְאַבְנֵ֥ט בַּד֙ יַחְגֹּ֔ר וּבְמִצְנֶ֥פֶת בַּ֖ד יִצְנֹ֑ף בִּגְדֵי־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔ם וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וּלְבֵשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: And he shall take from the congregation of Israel two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must take animals from the people of Israel.
He must take two male goats.
He must use the two goats for a sin offering.
He must also take one ram.
He must use the ram for a burnt offering.
passages.original: וּמֵאֵ֗ת עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִקַּ֛ח שְׁנֵֽי־ שְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְאַ֥יִל אֶחָ֖ד לְעֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: Aaron is to present the bull for his sin offering and make atonement for himself and his household.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must bring a bull as a sin offering.
This bull is for Aaron’s own sin.
Aaron must offer the bull to God.
Aaron makes atonement for himself with this offering.
Aaron also makes atonement for his household with this offering.
passages.original: וְהִקְרִ֧יב אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־ פַּ֥ר הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then he shall take the two goats and present them before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must take two male goats from the people of Israel.
Aaron must bring the two goats to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
Aaron must present the two goats before the LORD.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֖ח אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֣י הַשְּׂעִירִ֑ם וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: After Aaron casts lots for the two goats, one for the LORD and the other for the scapegoat, he shall present the goat chosen by lot for the LORD and sacrifice it as a sin offering.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron takes two goats.
Aaron casts lots over the two goats.
One lot is for the LORD.
One lot is for the scapegoat.
Aaron selects the goat that receives the lot for the LORD.
Aaron presents this goat before the LORD.
Aaron sacrifices this goat as a sin offering.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֧ן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עַל־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׂעִירִ֖ם גּוֹרָל֑וֹת גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְגוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָ֖ד לַעֲזָאזֵֽל׃ וְהִקְרִ֤יב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָלָ֥ה עָלָ֛יו הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לַיהוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֖הוּ חַטָּֽאת׃

passages.text: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD to make atonement by sending it into the wilderness as the scapegoat.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
He stands before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
He takes two goats.
He casts lots over the two goats.
One lot is for the LORD.
The other lot is for Azazel, the scapegoat.
The goat that receives the lot for Azazel is the scapegoat.
Aaron presents this goat alive before the LORD.
This goat stands alive before the LORD.
Aaron uses this goat to make atonement.
Aaron sends this goat away into the wilderness as the scapegoat.
passages.original: וְהַשָּׂעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁר֩ עָלָ֨ה עָלָ֤יו הַגּוֹרָל֙ לַעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יָֽעֳמַד־ חַ֛י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו לְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֹת֛וֹ לַעֲזָאזֵ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃

passages.text: When Aaron presents the bull for his sin offering and makes atonement for himself and his household, he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must bring a bull as a sin offering.
This bull is for Aaron’s own sin.
This bull is also for the sins of Aaron’s household.
Aaron must make atonement for himself.
Aaron must make atonement for his household.
Aaron must slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.
passages.original: וְהִקְרִ֨יב אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ פַּ֤ר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּֽעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֑וֹ וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־ פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then he must take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense, and take them inside the veil.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
\r\nAaron must take a censer.
\r\nHe must fill the censer with burning coals.
\r\nHe must take the burning coals from the altar.
\r\nThe altar stands before the LORD.
\r\nAaron must also take two handfuls of incense.
\r\nThe incense must be finely ground and fragrant.
\r\nAaron must bring the censer and the incense.
\r\nHe must take them inside the veil.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֣ח מְלֹֽא־ הַ֠מַּחְתָּה גַּֽחֲלֵי־ אֵ֞שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמְלֹ֣א חָפְנָ֔יו קְטֹ֥רֶת סַמִּ֖ים דַּקָּ֑ה וְהֵבִ֖יא מִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃

passages.text: He is to put the incense on the fire before the LORD, and the cloud of incense will cover the mercy seat above the Testimony, so that he will not die.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must put the incense on the fire.
He must do this before the LORD.
The incense will make a cloud of smoke.
The cloud will cover the mercy seat.
The mercy seat is above the Testimony.
The cloud will protect Aaron.
Aaron will not die.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֧ן אֶֽת־ הַקְּטֹ֛רֶת עַל־ הָאֵ֖שׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְכִסָּ֣ה׀ עֲנַ֣ן הַקְּטֹ֗רֶת אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָעֵד֖וּת וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃

passages.text: And he is to take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the east side of the mercy seat; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the mercy seat.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must take some blood from the bull.
He must use his finger to sprinkle the blood.
He must sprinkle the blood on the east side of the mercy seat.
He must also sprinkle the blood with his finger seven times in front of the mercy seat.
passages.original: וְלָקַח֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֧ה בְאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת קֵ֑דְמָה וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת יַזֶּ֧ה שֶֽׁבַע־ פְּעָמִ֛ים מִן־ הַדָּ֖ם בְּאֶצְבָּעֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Aaron shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and bring its blood behind the veil, and with its blood he must do as he did with the bull’s blood: He is to sprinkle it against the mercy seat and in front of it.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must slaughter the goat.
This goat is the sin offering for the people.
Aaron must take the goat’s blood.
He must bring the blood behind the veil.
Aaron must treat the goat’s blood as he treated the bull’s blood.
He must sprinkle the goat’s blood on the mercy seat.
He must also sprinkle the goat’s blood in front of the mercy seat.
passages.original: וְשָׁחַ֞ט אֶת־ שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֔ם וְהֵבִיא֙ אֶת־ דָּמ֔וֹ אֶל־ מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת וְעָשָׂ֣ה אֶת־ דָּמ֗וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְדַ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ עַל־ הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃

passages.text: So he shall make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the impurities and rebellious acts of the Israelites in regard to all their sins. He is to do the same for the Tent of Meeting which abides among them, because it is surrounded by their impurities.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must make atonement for the Most Holy Place.
He does this because the Israelites are impure.
The Israelites have committed rebellious acts.
The Israelites have sinned in many ways.
Aaron must also make atonement for the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting is where God lives among the Israelites.
The Tent of Meeting is surrounded by the impurities of the Israelites.
passages.original: וְכִפֶּ֣ר עַל־ הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־ חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְכֵ֤ן יַעֲשֶׂה֙ לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַשֹּׁכֵ֣ן אִתָּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: No one may be in the Tent of Meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he leaves, after he has made atonement for himself, his household, and the whole assembly of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron entered the Most Holy Place to make atonement.
No one else could be in the Tent of Meeting while Aaron was inside.
Aaron went in alone to make atonement in the Most Holy Place.
No one could enter until Aaron came out.
Aaron made atonement for himself.
Aaron made atonement for his household.
Aaron made atonement for the whole assembly of Israel.
passages.original: וְכָל־ אָדָ֞ם לֹא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה׀ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד בְּבֹא֛וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַד־ צֵאת֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֤ר בַּעֲדוֹ֙ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֔וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כָּל־ קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it. He is to take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must go out to the altar.
This altar stands before the LORD.
Aaron must make atonement for the altar.
He must take some blood from the bull.
He must also take some blood from the goat.
Aaron must put this blood on all the horns of the altar.
He must put the blood around the altar.
passages.original: וְיָצָ֗א אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְלָקַ֞ח מִדַּ֤ם הַפָּר֙ וּמִדַּ֣ם הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְנָתַ֛ן עַל־ קַרְנ֥וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must take some of the blood.
Aaron must use his finger.
Aaron must sprinkle the blood on the altar.
Aaron must sprinkle the blood seven times.
Aaron does this to cleanse the altar.
Aaron does this to make the altar holy.
Aaron removes the uncleanness of the Israelites from the altar.
passages.original: וְהִזָּ֨ה עָלָ֧יו מִן־ הַדָּ֛ם בְּאֶצְבָּע֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִהֲר֣וֹ וְקִדְּשׁ֔וֹ מִטֻּמְאֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: When Aaron has finished purifying the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he is to bring forward the live goat.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron purifies the Most Holy Place.
Aaron purifies the Tent of Meeting.
Aaron purifies the altar.
After Aaron finishes these acts of purification, he brings forward the live goat.
passages.original: וְכִלָּה֙ מִכַּפֵּ֣ר אֶת־ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְהִקְרִ֖יב אֶת־ הַשָּׂעִ֥יר הֶחָֽי׃

passages.text: Then he is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the iniquities and rebellious acts of the Israelites in regard to all their sins. He is to put them on the goat’s head and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man appointed for the task.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must take the live goat.
Aaron must place both his hands on the head of the live goat.
Aaron must confess all the sins of the Israelites over the goat.
Aaron must confess all their iniquities.
Aaron must confess all their rebellious acts.
Aaron must confess all their sins.
Aaron must put all these sins on the head of the goat.
Aaron must send the goat away into the wilderness.
A man chosen for this task must lead the goat into the wilderness.
passages.original: וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדוֹ עַ֨ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר֮ הַחַי֒ וְהִתְוַדָּ֣ה עָלָ֗יו אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲוֺנֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־ חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְנָתַ֤ן אֹתָם֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשִׁלַּ֛ח בְּיַד־ אִ֥ישׁ עִתִּ֖י הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃

passages.text: The goat will carry on itself all their iniquities into a solitary place, and the man will release it into the wilderness.
passages.sermon:
The goat is alive.
The goat will carry all the sins of the Israelites on itself.
The goat will take these sins to a deserted place.
A man will release the goat into the wilderness.
passages.original: וְנָשָׂ֨א הַשָּׂעִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲוֺנֹתָ֖ם אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ גְּזֵרָ֑ה וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ הַשָּׂעִ֖יר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: Then Aaron is to enter the Tent of Meeting, take off the linen garments he put on before entering the Most Holy Place, and leave them there.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must enter the Tent of Meeting.
He must take off the linen garments.
He wore these linen garments when he entered the Most Holy Place.
He must leave these garments in the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וּבָ֤א אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָבַ֖שׁ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: He is to bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his own clothes. Then he must go out and sacrifice his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering to make atonement for himself and for the people.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must wash his body with water.
He must do this in a holy place.
Aaron must put on his own clothes.
Then Aaron must go out from the holy place.
Aaron must offer his burnt offering to God.
Aaron must also offer the people’s burnt offering to God.
Aaron makes atonement for himself.
Aaron makes atonement for the people.
passages.original: וְרָחַ֨ץ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֤וֹ בַמַּ֙יִם֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָד֔וֹשׁ וְלָבַ֖שׁ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֑יו וְיָצָ֗א וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־ עֹֽלָתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ עֹלַ֣ת הָעָ֔ם וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: He is also to burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
passages.sermon: Aaron is the high priest of Israel.\r\nAaron must burn the fat of the sin offering.\r\nHe must burn it on the altar.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛ת חֵ֥לֶב הַֽחַטָּ֖את יַקְטִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

passages.text: The man who released the goat as the scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may reenter the camp.
passages.sermon:
A man released the goat as the scapegoat.
This man must wash his clothes.
He must bathe his body with water.
After he washes and bathes, he may enter the camp.
passages.original: וְהַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֤חַ אֶת־ הַשָּׂעִיר֙ לַֽעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְרָחַ֥ץ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן יָב֥וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

passages.text: The bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement, must be taken outside the camp; and their hides, flesh, and dung must be burned up.
passages.sermon:
The priest brings the bull for the sin offering.
He also brings the goat for the sin offering.
The blood of these animals was brought into the Most Holy Place.
The blood was used to make atonement.
The priest must take the bull and the goat outside the camp.
He must burn their hides with fire.
He must burn their flesh with fire.
He must burn their dung with fire.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ פַּ֨ר הַֽחַטָּ֜את וְאֵ֣ת׀ שְׂעִ֣יר הַֽחַטָּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּבָ֤א אֶת־ דָּמָם֙ לְכַפֵּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יוֹצִ֖יא אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְשָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ אֶת־ עֹרֹתָ֥ם וְאֶת־ בְּשָׂרָ֖ם וְאֶת־ פִּרְשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: The one who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and afterward he may reenter the camp.
passages.sermon:
The person burns the bull and the goat for the sin offering outside the camp.
This person must wash his clothes.
He must bathe his body with water.
After he does this, he may enter the camp.
passages.original: וְהַשֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְרָחַ֥ץ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן יָב֥וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

passages.text: This is to be a permanent statute for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month, you shall humble yourselves and not do any work—whether the native or the foreigner who resides among you— because on this day atonement will be made for you to cleanse you, and you will be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a permanent law.
This law applies to all generations.
On the tenth day of the seventh month, you must humble yourselves.
You must not do any work on this day.
This command is for every native-born Israelite.
This command is also for every foreigner living among you.
On this day, atonement will be made for you.
Atonement will cleanse you from all your sins.
You will be clean before the LORD.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ֠שְּׁבִיעִי בֶּֽעָשׂ֨וֹר לַחֹ֜דֶשׁ תְּעַנּ֣וּ אֶת־ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֗ם וְכָל־ מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ הָֽאֶזְרָ֔ח וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃ כִּֽי־ בַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה יְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְטַהֵ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם מִכֹּל֙ חַטֹּ֣אתֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תִּטְהָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: It is a Sabbath of complete rest for you, that you may humble yourselves; it is a permanent statute.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
He said, "This day is a Sabbath of complete rest for you."
You must humble yourselves on this day.
This rule will last forever.
passages.original: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן הִיא֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֖ת עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest shall make atonement. He will put on the sacred linen garments and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, and for the priests and all the people of the assembly.
passages.sermon:
The high priest is a man anointed and ordained to succeed his father.
He puts on the sacred linen garments.
He makes atonement for the Most Holy Place.
He makes atonement for the Tent of Meeting.
He makes atonement for the altar.
He makes atonement for the priests.
He makes atonement for all the people of the assembly.
passages.original: וְכִפֶּ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲשֶׁר־ יִמְשַׁ֣ח אֹת֗וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יְמַלֵּא֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ לְכַהֵ֖ן תַּ֣חַת אָבִ֑יו וְלָבַ֛שׁ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד בִּגְדֵ֥י הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ וְכִפֶּר֙ אֶת־ מִקְדַּ֣שׁ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יְכַפֵּ֑ר וְעַ֧ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְעַל־ כָּל־ עַ֥ם הַקָּהָ֖ל יְכַפֵּֽר׃

passages.text: This is to be a permanent statute for you, to make atonement once a year for the Israelites because of all their sins.” And all this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
This command is a permanent law.
The law requires atonement for the Israelites.
The atonement covers all their sins.
The atonement happens once every year.
The people did everything as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וְהָֽיְתָה־ זֹּ֨את לָכֶ֜ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֗ם לְכַפֵּ֞ר עַל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִכָּל־ חַטֹּאתָ֔ם אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
